title: Kaleidoscope
description: Draw once, get ten drawings: a pointer sketch mirrored into a living mandala.
usage: The stage draws by itself until you touch it — a slow lissajous pen — then your strokes take over, mirrored across ten segments. The Clear button is the only adult in the room. Screenshots of it make excellent album covers and terrible documentation.
a11y: A drawing toy: the canvas carries a plain label, and nothing on any sane page may depend on what gets drawn. Under prefers-reduced-motion the pen rests and the stage waits, blank and patient, for a hand.
